Make a new supplement site from the template

Source: R/create-supplement.R
create_supplement.Rd

create_supplement() copies the package's Quarto website template into path. It is an R route in place of quarto use template jmgirard/supplement/inst/template: it copies the template that is installed with the package, and it needs no Quarto command-line interface and no network.

Usage

create_supplement(path, repo = NULL)

Arguments

path

The folder for the site. It is made if it does not exist.

repo

The GitHub repository of the site, as "owner/name", or NULL. When given, it replaces each OWNER/REPO placeholder in _quarto.yml, and the GitHub Pages address in _README.md and GUIDE.md becomes https://<owner>.github.io/<name>/ with the owner in lowercase. For a repository named <owner>.github.io, the address is https://<owner>.github.io/. When NULL, the placeholders stay for you to edit.

Value

path, invisibly.

Details

path can be a new folder or an existing one, such as a clone of a new GitHub repository. The function never replaces a file and never follows a link: if path already holds a file, a folder, or a link where the template writes a file, or a file or a link where the template needs a folder, it stops before it writes anything.

The template ships _gitignore and _README.md under those names, because quarto use template does not copy .gitignore or README.md. The first quarto render gives them their real names, and that render adds the template's rules that an existing .gitignore lacks and ends it with !docs/ and !_freeze/. These two lines cannot undo a rule such as docs/* or *.html. _README.md is the page for the site's readers. If README.md exists, the render keeps it and removes _README.md. The guide for the site's authors is GUIDE.md. Render the site once before your first commit.

After it makes the site, the function runs the lookups of check_tools(). Its closing message names each tool that is missing, too old, or not on the system path. A tool never stops the function, and the site is the same whether the tools are found or not.

Hidden files and folders in the template folder are not copied, and neither are docs, _freeze, or _site folders at its top level, which hold render output.

Errors

The errors that the function raises itself have the class supplement_error and one of these classes:

  • supplement_error_argument: path is not a single non-missing, non-empty character string.

  • supplement_error_repo: repo is not NULL or a single string of the form owner/name. The owner must be 1 to 39 ASCII letters and digits, with single - between them. The name must be 1 to 100 ASCII letters, digits, -, _, and ., and must not be . or ...

  • supplement_error_not_folder: path is an existing file, or a link whose target is missing. A / at the end of path does not change this.

  • supplement_error_file_exists: path holds a file, a folder, or a link where the template writes a file, or a file or a link where the template needs a folder.

  • supplement_error_write: a folder could not be made, a file could not be copied, or the repository could not be written into a copied file, for example because a parent of path is a file. The function then removes the files and folders that it made.

See also

write_citation() and write_zenodo() for the citation files.

Examples

site <- file.path(tempdir(), "my-supplement")
create_supplement(site, repo = "jdoe/my-supplement")
#> ✔ Made a supplement site in /tmp/RtmpLn1To3/my-supplement.
#> ℹ Put the paper facts in _supplement.yml.
#> ℹ Run `quarto render` in /tmp/RtmpLn1To3/my-supplement once before your first
#>   commit.
list.files(site, recursive = TRUE)
#>  [1] "GUIDE.md"                             
#>  [2] "LICENSE-CC-BY.md"                     
#>  [3] "LICENSE.md"                           
#>  [4] "_README.md"                           
#>  [5] "_extensions/supplement/_extension.yml"
#>  [6] "_extensions/supplement/supplement.lua"
#>  [7] "_gitignore"                           
#>  [8] "_quarto.yml"                          
#>  [9] "_scripts/nojekyll.lua"                
#> [10] "_scripts/report.R"                    
#> [11] "_scripts/setup.lua"                   
#> [12] "_supplement.yml"                      
#> [13] "analyses/example.qmd"                 
#> [14] "data/example.csv"                     
#> [15] "figures/bootstrap-means.png"          
#> [16] "index.qmd"                            
unlink(site, recursive = TRUE)
